QuestInfo.name: Knight's Cavalier
QuestInfo.0: Kimu has prepared something for you.
QuestInfo.1:
Try out the #bKnight's Cavalier hat#k Kimu gave you.\n

#e[How to Equip]#n\n
1. Open the item inventory window by pressing the hotkey I.\n
2. Double-click on the hat, or left-click and drag it into your Equip window to equip.\n
3. Open the Equip window by pressing the hotkey E to make sure it's equipped.\n
QuestInfo.2: You have learned how to equip items! Press the hotkey I to open the inventory window, and then double-click on the item to equip it. Open the Equip window by pressing the hotkey E, and double-click on the item to unequip it.

1.0: Putting on equipment's easy, huh? It's a good thing, because you're gonna need a lot better gear to be a real knight! Keep an eye out for new stuff all the time.

yes.0: I found Kinu in a pile of books. He'll tell you what you need to know, or possibly just put you to sleep. Or both.

default.0:
Where's that hat I gave you? I want to see how cool you look. Open your inventory and equip it!
Equipped gear can be accessed by pressing the #bE#k key.

 

You didn't toss it, did you? Don't just go throwing things out all willy-nilly. You need to be tactical!
